svg.title: Exact move card, head minus Depth Anything 3 plus rules
svg.desc: Exact move card, head minus DA3 plus rules, paired 95% CI, two seeds per training mix, across four test sets. On test_scenes and test_moving every mix except D-H is 18 to 26 points above zero. On test_combos every mix is below zero (D-GFH -13.6 and -13.8, D-G -4.6 and -3.8 with CIs crossing zero, D-F -15.8 and -20.0, D-H -49.0 and -48.4). On test_human moving windows every mix is 13 to 41 points below zero.
